segments.name: Medical Aesthetics
segments.description: Sells injectable neurotoxins and injectable hyaluronic acid gels to licensed aesthetic practitioners serving cash-pay consumers in the United States, Europe and other markets.
segments.evidence: We currently operate one reportable segment, and our net product revenues are derived from the sale of Jeuveau ® and, beginning in April 2025, from the sale of Evolysse™.

revenueModel.text: Licensed aesthetic practitioners pay the company for injectable aesthetic products, including neurotoxins and hyaluronic acid gels, which consumers pay for directly out of pocket.
revenueModel.evidence: Our customers are aesthetic practitioners who are properly licensed to deliver our products.
